sentences.text: IPMA has issued rough sea warnings for the Lisboa district: yellow from 2026-11-18 21:17 to 2026-11-19 06:00 local time, orange from 2026-11-19 06:00 to 12:00 local time, and yellow from 12:00 to 2026-11-20 09:00 local time.
Today's forecast for Lisboa has a minimum of 15.9 °C and a maximum of 20.9 °C, with a 100% chance of rain and a moderate wind from the W.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-19, the forecast for Lisboa is a minimum of 12.8 °C and a maximum of 18.5 °C, with a 2% chance of rain and a moderate wind from the W.
The IPMA sea forecast for the Lisboa coast on 2026-11-19 gives waves of 3.5 to 4 metres from the NW and a sea temperature of 17.4 to 17.5 °C.
